description: This C# source file defines the CommentsController class, which manages HTTP endpoints for creating, retrieving, and deleting comments on articles within the Conduit application. It uses MediatR for command/query handling, and ASP.NET Core MVC features for routing and authorization.

classes.name: CommentsController
classes.description: Controller handling comment-related HTTP requests such as creating, listing, and deleting comments on articles.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST requests to create a new comment on an article identified by slug.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to retrieve comments for a specified article.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Handles HTTP DELETE requests to remove a specific comment by ID from an article.
